description: Header file declaring functions and types for managing Wi-Fi hostapd configurations, including loading, creating, deleting, and modifying configurations, as well as retrieving configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads hostapd configuration from a file specified by path.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_createConfig
methods.description: Creates a new hostapd configuration associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the current hostapd configuration to a file.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to a specific BSS in the configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_delConfigParam
methods.description: Deletes a parameter from a specific BSS in the configuration.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMap
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration map for a specific BSS.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamValStr
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific parameter as a string for a BSS.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigMapByBssid
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration map for a BSS identified by BSSID.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_getConfigParamByBssidValStr
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific parameter as a string for a BSS identified by BSSID.
